'''Ian Ericson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 1999 St Albans tournament]] on 26 September 1999 with Y4 Throne Room mains (no Revolution), according to Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d53">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-st-albans-uk-9-26-99d53/ st-albans-uk-9-26-99], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 27 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-st-albans-uk-9-26-99d53/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
